title: Madagascar Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Climate-development diagnostics and recent Grand Sud impacts reported in 2024
methodology: Country diagnostic combining climate risks, development analysis and regional vulnerability discussion.
limitations: Grand Sud impacts include pandemic, market, poverty and institutional factors; climate's causal contribution to hunger or violence is not isolated.

title: Madagascar Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0
temporal_coverage: Recent disaster and displacement information and climate projections summarized in the 2026 NDC
methodology: National contribution synthesizes climate, vulnerability and disaster information from cited studies.
limitations: French document; passages summarize cited figures, not a harmonized impact series.
